title: Senior Principal Engineer , Guidance & Control (Grade 6)
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description: About The Role Shape the future of precision-guided systems. At Al Tariq we are seeking an experienced Senior Principal Engineer - Guidance & Control to lead the development and implementation of advanced flight control software for next-generation smart weapon systems. This is a highly technical role offering the opportunity to work across the full product lifecycle, from concept development and modelling through to flight testing, validation, and production support. As a subject matter expert in guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), you will play a critical role in designing and delivering high-performance control systems that meet stringent operational, safety, and military requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and maintenance of Guidance & Control algorithms for smart weapon systems. Design and optimise autopilot and mission control software to meet performance requirements. Develop and maintain Launch Acceptable Region (LAR) and Mission Planning System (MPS) algorithms. Own and enhance 6-Degree-of-Freedom (6-DOF) simulation models and support Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation (HILS) activities. Validate and maintain aerodynamic models using flight test data. Analyse system requirements and translate them into effective software solutions. Design software architectures and develop code using C, C++, MATLAB, and Simulink. Execute software verification and validation activities to ensure compliance with programme requirements. Ensure compliance with aerospace and defence software standards, including DO-178 and MIL-STD frameworks. Conduct flight, laboratory, and ground testing, including data analysis and performance reporting. Manage software configuration, traceability, technical documentation, and change control processes. Support production, fault investigations, and multidisciplinary engineering teams in resolving technical challenges. Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering /Electronic Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Computer Science Or an equivalent technical discipline Master's Degree preferred. Experience 10-15 years of experience within the smart weapons, guided munitions, missile, aerospace, or defence industry. Extensive experience in: Guidance systems Flight control systems Kalman filtering Modelling and simulation Strong software development capability using C / C++ / MATLAB / Simulink Experience with 6-DOF modelling , HILS environments , Aerodynamic modelling & Flight-test data analysis Working knowledge of military and commercial aerospace standards.
